# Md. Shakibur Rahaman - Strategic Lead & Digital Architect & Digital Growth Architect

> Full-Stack Creative Director delivering integrated branding, visual design, web engineering, omnichannel marketing, commercial cinematography, and live experiential activations.

## 9 Core Service Pillars
1. **Branding**: Comprehensive brand strategy, brand positioning, brand architecture, corporate identity manuals, brand guidelines, and tone of voice.
2. **Graphics Design**: Visual identity systems, logo marks, UI/UX interface design, luxury packaging, editorial print, and high-impact marketing collateral.
3. **Web Design & Development**: 15+ live deployed web platforms, headless e-commerce, custom web apps, API architecture, and 95+ PageSpeed performance.
4. **Social Media Marketing (SMM)**: Omnichannel strategy, viral short-form video reels, community growth, and Meta Advantage+ paid scaling.
5. **Photoshoot & Videography**: Commercial broadcast TVCs, cinematic product shoots, brand documentaries, high-retention video reels, and aerial drone cinematography.
6. **Event Activation & Exhibition**: 3D booth design & custom fabrication, B2B trade show installations, corporate galas, and experiential brand activations.
7. **Google Ads**: High-intent Search, Performance Max, YouTube conversion funnels, and granular GA4 multi-touch attribution.
8. **SEO & AEO**: Technical on-page SEO, generative AI engine optimization (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini), /llms.txt context, and Schema.org knowledge graph.
9. **PR (Public Relations)**: Strategic press release distribution, tier-1 media placements, crisis communications, and executive thought leadership.
